comment.narrative: New EU cooperation at regional level no historic regional cooperation exists as baseline

The project will contribute to the enhancement of aviation efficiency and capacity safety sustainability and mutual awareness through a stronger partnership in these areas between the EU and North Asian Partner countries

Due to Description box letter count limit I paste here the remainder of the text ... everincreasing important area sustainable aviation is improved through a comprehensive dialogue with partner country authorities and stakeholders on sustainable aviation strategies and a consistent promotion of environmental technologies and solutions from industry as well as effective regulatory policies e.g. on Sustainable Aviation Fuels SAF through organising activities via the cooperation platform that the project offers. One activity on general sustainable aviation strategies was already organised with China and one with Japan. These activities allowed DG MOVE to present the EU initiatives for Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy and enhance the European Green Deal. European and ChineseJapanese aviation stakeholders including industry presented their contributions to environmental protection exploring possible areas of collaboration to achieve common goals towards sustainable aviation. The subject of SAF is likely to remain a focus of exchanges in this domain with one targeted workshop already organised with each of the three North Asian partner countries and another one planned for each as well in 2024 dedicated to SAF and other renewable aviation energies with ROK and Japan and dedicated to SAF qualification with China.
